title: Crouzeix's Conjecture
exact_target: Is the operator norm of every analytic function of a complex matrix at most twice the maximum magnitude of that function on the matrix’s numerical range?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1449 (ALG-004). CC BY 4.0.
Emiel Lorist and Felix L. Schwenninger, A Solution to Crouzeix’s Conjecture, arXiv:2608.03841v2 (2026), Section 1, equation (1), and Theorem 3 with its holomorphic functional-calculus formulation.
